_doc: The 5 mm slot of Motedis' I-type profiles (20 mm series). Motedis prints the opening and the depth; it sells the section as I-type, made to match item's Line 5 groove, so the lip and the cavity's width are item's figures, marked community until a bar is measured. The floor and flanks are item's as scaled off its drawing.
name: slot-5-motedis

opening.rule: Slot width, "5" on the data picture ("Nutbreite: 5 mm" on the page)
opening.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-20x20-I-Typ-Nut-5", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-20x20-I-Typ-Nut-5

lip_thickness.rule: Lip thickness: Motedis prints none. item's figure for the groove this is made to match (slot-5-item)
lip_thickness.source: slot-5-item rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips: Motedis prints none. item's figure (slot-5-item)
cavity_width.source: slot-5-item rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

cavity_depth.rule: Slot depth, "6,35" on the data picture
cavity_depth.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-20x20-I-Typ-Nut-5", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-20x20-I-Typ-Nut-5

floor_width.rule: Width of the floor: as slot-5-item, itself scaled off item's drawing
floor_width.source: slot-5-item rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, as slot-5-item
flank_angle.source: slot-5-item rule set; Motedis calls the section I-type

nut_family.rule: Sold as I-type: it takes nuts made for item's Line 5 groove
nut_family.source: Motedis, product page and data picture "Aluprofil-20x20-I-Typ-Nut-5", https://www.motedis.com/de/Aluprofil-20x20-I-Typ-Nut-5
